floor.note: snowfield; has rocks in it, so it reads as a grid under 30ish: keep the repeat large and the overlay on

bed.note: floor of a frozen pit (not under water: beds under water keep the floor texture)

foot.note: cliff-foot atlas: v 1 is snow at the ground, rock towards 0.5, snow again towards 0; u tiles; the last 1/8 of u is a separate brighter strip, so stay under 0.86. Measured from 7,903 of Beaucedine's own triangles

overlay.note: noise-faded snow pass that breaks up the floor repeat

water.note: borrowed from Dragon's Aery's look; static here (Aery animates its water with effect generators)

log.note: snowy roots: made to be half buried
